proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4272 *goḍḍa gives Nepali goṛo, Maithili goṛ and Hindi goṛā leg. Dang gora and Danuwar ghor fit this regional leg family with plain rhotic and, in ghor, aspiration retained as comparative qualifications. Exact survey form gʰor is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11813 *vibhāna gives bihān morning and addenda bhyaiṇi/byāṇi dawn. Danuwar bihani is compared with this morning family, retaining its ending; Turner also allows derivation through the related vibhāyana verbal noun. Exact survey form bihani is preserved.
